Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    wallcol=min(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    rs=[r for r in range(h) if any(inp[r][c]==wallcol for c in range(w))]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if any(inp[r][c]==wallcol for r in range(h))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # fill interior of frame bbox excluding wall cells
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if out[r][c]!=wallcol: out[r][c]=4
    def paint(r,c):
        if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w: out[r][c]=4
    gt=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if inp[r0][c]!=wallcol]
    gb=[c for c in range(c0,c1+1) if inp[r1][c]!=wallcol]
    gapsL=[r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if inp[r][c0]!=wallcol]
    gapsR=[r for r in range(r0,r1+1) if inp[r][c1]!=wallcol]
    # left gap
    if gapsL and not gapsR and not gt and not gb:
        g=gapsL; cw=c0
        for r in g:
            cc=cw-1
            while True:
                cc-=1
                if cc<0: break
                paint(r,cc)
        rr=(g[0]-1,cw-1)
        while True:
            rr=(rr[0]-1,rr[1]-1)
            if rr[0]<0 or rr[1]<0: break
            paint(rr[0],rr[1])
        rr=(g[-1]+1,cw-1)
        while True:
            rr=(rr[0]+1,rr[1]-1)
            if rr[0]>=h or rr[1]<0: break
            paint(rr[0],rr[1])
    elif gapsR and not gapsL and not gt and not gb:
        g=gapsR; cw=c1
        for r in g:
            cc=cw
            while True:
                cc+=1
                if cc>=w: break
                paint(r,cc)
        rr=(g[0]-1,cw+1)
        while True:
            rr=(rr[0]-1,rr[1]+1)
            if rr[0]<0 or rr[1]>=w: break
            paint(rr[0],rr[1])
        rr=(g[-1]+1,cw+1)
        while True:
            rr=(rr[0]+1,rr[1]+1)
            if rr[0]>=h or rr[1]>=w: break
            paint(rr[0],rr[1])
    return out

def solve(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in inp for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # wall color: color of frame; find the rectangular ring. try each color as wall
    def ring_cells(c):
        rs=[r for r in range(H) for c2 in range(W) if inp[r][c2]==c]
        cs=[c2 for r in range(H) for c2 in range(W) if inp[r][c2]==c]
        if not rs: return None
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        per=lambda rr,cc: inp[rr][cc]==c
        ok=all(per(r,c0) or per(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and all(per(r0,c) or per(r1,c) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
        if not ok: return None
        # interior
        interior=[(r,c2) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c2 in range(c0+1,c1) if inp[r][c2]!=c]
        return c,r0,r1,c0,c1,[(r,c2) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c2 in range(c0+1,c1) if inp[r][c2]==bg]
    for c in cnt:
        res=ring_cells(c)
        if res and len(res[5])>0: return res
    return None

def analyze(n):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # find wall color = most common on grid border? frame occupies border ring? use candidate colors and check ring structure
    from collections import Counter as Ct
    cnt=Ct(x for r in range(H) for x in inp[r])
    # wall color candidates: color whose cells form two rows + two cols (a rect) - try each
    res={}
    for col in cnt:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==col]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        # check: does every cell on perimeter of bbox belong to col set (allow gaps)? 
        per=[inp[r][c0] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r][c1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)][:-h]+[inp[r1][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)][:-w]
        nper=len(per)-h-w
        per_all=[inp[r][c0] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r][c1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]+[inp[r1][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
        # interior consistency: all interior cells same other color (the fill color)
        inner={inp[r][c] for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if inp[r][c]!=col}
        ok=(Ct(per_all)==Ct(col) or sum(p==col for p in per_all)>len(per_all)*0.5) and len(inner)<=2
        if ok: res[col]=(r0,r1,c0,c1,h,w)
    return res
for n in [1,2,3]:
    print(n, analyze(n))

def find_ring(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cols=[x for r in inp for x in r]
    cnt=Ct2(cols); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # candidate wall colors: color whose bbox ring has >80% of its perimeter cells == it, and interior is non-wall uniform-ish
    res=[]
    for col in cnt:
        if col==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==col]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        per=[inp[r][c0] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r][c1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]+[inp[r1][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
        ok=sum(p==col for p in per)>len(per)*0.7
        inner={inp[r][c] for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if inp[r][c]!=col}
        res.append((col,(r0,r1,c0,c1),ok,inner))
    return res,bg
for n in [1,2,3]:
    rs,bg=find_ring(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    good=[(c,box,i,inn) for c,box,o,inn in rs if o]
    print(n,'bg',bg,'cands',[(c,b) for c,b,_,_ in good])

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Ct2(x for r in inp for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # ring color & bbox
    best=None
    for col in cnt:
        if col==bg: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==col]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        inner={(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)}
        if any(inp[r][c]==col for r,c in inner): continue
        per=[inp[r][c0] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r][c1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]+[inp[r0][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]+[inp[r1][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
        score=sum(p==col for p in per)/len(per)
        if best is None or score>best[0]: best=(score,col,(r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,col,(r0,r1,c0,c1)=best
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    dirs={'top':(-1,0),'bot':(1,0),'lef':(0,-1),'rig':(0,1)}
    sgns={'top':-1,'bot':1,'lef':-1,'rig':1}
    sides={name:[(r0,c) if name=='top' else (r1,c) if name=='bot' else (r,c0) if name=='lef' else (r,c1) for idx,c in enumerate(range(c0,c1+1)) if name in ('top','bot')] for name in ('top','bot')}
    sides['lef']=[(r,c0) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]; sides['rig']=[(r,c1) for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # fill interior bg
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if inp[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=4
    for name in ('top','bot','lef','rig'):
        g=[gc for gc in sides[name] if inp[gc[0]][gc[1]]!=col]
        if not g: continue
        dr,dc=dirs[name]; sgn=sgns[name]
        # straight rays from every gap cell
        for gc in g:
            rr,cc=gc[0]+dr,gc[1]+dc
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=4; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
        # endpoint diagonals: away from gap center along wall
        mid=(g[0][0]+g[-1][0])/2 if dc==0 else (g[0][1]+g[-1][1])/2
        eps=lambda ec: -1 if (ec[0]-mid if dc==0 else ec[1]-mid)>0 else 1   # vertical sign for vertical wall etc
        for ec,s in ((g[0],-1),(g[-1],1)):
            vr = -1 if (dc==0 and (ec[0]-mid)<0) else 1
            vc = -1 if (dc!=0 and (ec[1]-mid)<0) else 1
            # horizontal sign = outward normal
            hor = dc
            step=(hor,vr)
            rr,cc=ec[0]+step[0],ec[1]+step[1]
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=4; rr+=step[0]; cc+=step[1]
    return out
